name: Shu ni Majiwareba Akaku Naru
original_name: 主に交われば朱くなる
source:
Hajime is a normal guy who transfers into Elde Gakuen, a school for the wealthy. He soon learns that he needs to enter into a ‘master-servant’ relationship with another student. Surrounded by various different kinds of ojousamas, his school life has become more exciting.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/02/april-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一是个普通青年，转入专为富裕阶层设立的Elde学园。他很快得知，自己必须与另一名学生建立“主从”关系。被各种类型的大小姐围绕后，他的校园生活也变得更加精彩。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/04/02/april-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
